about_the_game:
Endgame-first ARPG. Infinite progression. No story—just the grind.

Test your limits in The Eternal Hunt, an action RPG built for those who crave deep character progression, powerful loot, and an ever-evolving endgame. Skip the filler—dive straight into the hunt.

🔥 MASTER THE GRIND

  • Brutal Combat & Customization: Choose your class, forge your build, and wield devastating abilities. Every decision matters.

  • Infinite Progression: Face Khazul’s Maze, Boss Encounters, Time Fragments, Anomalies, and The Execution Grounds, each offering scaling difficulty and leaderboards!

  • No Hand-Holding: No story campaign, no scripted moments—just pure ARPG gameplay focused on loot and power growth.

🛡️ LOOT WITHOUT LIMITS

  • Legendary Items & Crafting: Find, forge, and reroll your way to the perfect build with Vorrak’s Forge and powerful Currencies.

  • Unique Item Types: Equip Symbols that grant passive buffs while stored in your inventory, forcing tactical trade-offs.

  • Timewarped Affixes: Exclusive to Anomalies, these modifiers push affix values beyond normal limits.

  • Auction House: Trade your hard-earned wares with other players in exchange for Diamonds! (resets upon Season and exclusive Hardcore/Softcore houses).

⚔️ CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT & BUILDCRAFT

  • Class-Specific Passive Trees → Each Class (e.g., Pyromancer, Barbarian, Hunter) has a unique Passive Tree that provides stat boosts & enhancements tailored to their playstyle.

    • Each Class has 5 Core Skills that form a thematic attack pattern unique to that class.

    • Each Core Skill has 3 Core Upgrades, allowing you to modify and refine your build.

    • You won’t be able to select all Core Upgrades, meaning strategic choices are required.

  • Skill Gems & Support Gems → Further customize your playstyle by slotting gems into your Relic and Charm.

    • Skill Gems → Grant access to globally useful Active Skills, such as:

      • Auras (e.g., increased damage, resistances).

      • Banners (temporary power boosts).

      • Movement Skills (dash, teleport, etc.).

    • Support Gems → Provide passive stat boosts that are always active, such as:

      • % Increased Fire Damage

      • + Levels to Active Skills

    • Advanced Skill Gems drop exclusively from Khazul, making endgame challenges a key part of unlocking the most powerful abilities.

🏹 ENDGAME CONTENT THAT NEVER STOPS

  • Khazul’s Maze: A procedural, multi-floor dungeon with increasing difficulty and endless cycles.

            

  • The Execution Grounds: Time-based survival trials that test your speed and efficiency.

  • Boss Encounters: Face off in a 1v1 battle to the death with the biggest and toughest bosses around!

  • Time Fragments: Customizable maps where you control the risk and rewards.

           

  • Anomalies: Level 100+ rifts with extreme modifiers, multiple boss encounters, and the best loot in the game.

🌎 MULTIPLAYER & COMPETITION

  • Solo or Co-op: Take on the hunt alone or with friends in drop-in multiplayer.

  • Persistent Hub: Trade, showcase your build, and queue up with players in the dedicated server lobby.

  • Leaderboards & Seasons: Compete in high-score leaderboards for Khazul’s Maze and Execution Grounds, with seasonal resets and exclusive rewards.

⚒️ EARLY ACCESS & COMMUNITY FEEDBACK

We’re launching in Early Access to fine-tune balance, add new content, and integrate community feedback. Expect frequent updates, new gear, fresh challenges, and evolving endgame mechanics.

💀 NO STORY. JUST THE GRIND. Are you ready for The Eternal Hunt?

💬 Join the Community:

🔹 Wishlist Now 🔹 Join Discord 🔹 Join X🔹 Follow for Updates

Note: This game is designed for players who love deep buildcraft, endless progression, and tough endgame challenges. If you seek a narrative-driven ARPG, this may not be for you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 with 6GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Storage space will fluctuate!
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600-XT with 6GB+ GB of VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Storage space will fluctuate!
